empty.text: Metrics appear once players finish rounds. We never show fake numbers.

analytics.title: Aggregate analytics
analytics.subtitle: Trends and game popularity comparison.
analytics.privacy: Only aggregate data is shown. Player-level analytics are not shared with marketing and never used to target vulnerable players.

users.title: User management
users.subtitle: Search users, review aggregate activity, suspend accounts and handle support requests.
users.search: Search email, username or display name
users.aggregateNote: Only aggregate summaries are shown; personal behavioural history is not exposed.

games.title: Game configuration
games.subtitle: Enable/disable games, edit metadata and manage rules versions. A new version never changes rounds in progress.
games.versionHelp: Edit the configuration JSON then validate. The server checks structure, stake limits and RTP (must not exceed 100%).
games.publishWarn: This version will apply to new rounds for all players. Rounds in progress keep their old version.

economy.title: Virtual economy
economy.subtitle: Set free rewards and the starting balance. There is no coin purchase; all coins are free.
economy.issuanceNote: Issuance = all coins credited other than game returns.
economy.reconcileBad: {n} wallets do not match the ledger!

missions.title: Mission management
missions.subtitle: Create and tune missions with free virtual coin rewards or badges.
missions.guard: Requirement types are limited to exploration activities — there is no requirement to raise stakes, chase losses or play continuously.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: A record of every sensitive administrative action.
